Common pests

Identify the intruder

These are the pests we see most around Chino and Covina. Facing a pest problem can be discouraging and stressful — our team is dedicated to promptly addressing your concerns.

Termites

Termites are one of the U.S.’s most destructive pests — the average damage to a home runs between $7,000 and $8,000, and most house insurance doesn’t cover it.

Ants

Ants enter houses in search of food. Their nests are often on lawns, in warm, dry soil and under paving — look for finely powdered soil.

Rats

Black rats are among the most common in the U.S. Signs include droppings and teeth marks on electric cables — which can be a fire hazard.

Bees

Bees are useful, but hives can damage your property or threaten family members who are allergic to bee stings.

Spiders

One of the most feared home invaders. A bite by the wrong spider — a black widow or brown recluse — can be painful and even dangerous.

Mice

House mice are active all year, nesting in warm, quiet places like walls or inside cabinets. They gnaw, damage furnishings and spread disease.
